campaign_name: PR-BR Continuation 11 — Structured Model Interpretation Integration
purpose: Wire the live scene catalog into interpretation validation and call a structured interpreter only after deterministic abstention. Same validator. Six focused live turns. No smoke. No 4x10 gate. PR-BR remains open.
executive_summary: Ordinary /api/chat now supplies a scene/referent catalog, so the unscoped nominal bridge is not used on that path. A structured interpreter runs only after the fast path abstains, once, and its Interpretation Proposal is accepted or rejected by the Continuation 10 validator. Deterministic band: 234 passed, 0 failed. Live turns: 6. Fast path: 4. Model-interpreted: 2. Both interpreted contracts were correct. Neither interpreted reply answered the player. Manual player-visible PASS 1/6. Evaluator PASS 5/6 with 4 false PASS. Interpretation calls 2. Generation calls 6. Evaluator model calls 0. Retries 0. READY FOR INDEPENDENT 10-TURN SMOKE: NO. READY FOR FULL SYNTHETIC GATE: NO. HUMAN PLAYTEST: NOT AUTHORIZED. HEAD d31beb7d73dd4fda0f22184a6a69b947b5f470ff, uncommitted.
